_about: One real source per category, all DISABLED. Robots notes were checked by hand on 2026-09-22; terms must be re-verified by a person before a source is enabled (PATCH enabled: true). Seeding never overwrites or enables an existing source.

sources.name: NASA news releases
sources.robots_note: robots.txt checked 2026-09-22: User-agent * Allow /. The fetcher re-checks it on every run.
sources.terms_note: NASA's media usage guidelines say NASA material is generally not subject to copyright in the US; logos, insignia and third-party material are excluded. Store titles, links and short summaries; link back. Re-verify before enabling.
sources.license_note: US federal government work in general; per-item credits may restrict reuse.

sources.name: Node.js blog
sources.robots_note: robots.txt checked 2026-09-22: only /dist/ and /docs/ are disallowed; the feed path is allowed.
sources.terms_note: Content of the OpenJS Foundation and contributors; read the site's terms before enabling. Titles, links and short summaries only.

sources.name: Steam user review signals: Portal 2 (app 620)
sources.terms_note: Documented store endpoint (partner.steamgames.com/doc/store/getreviews); Steam's terms apply. Review text belongs to its authors and is deliberately not mapped: signals only (recommendation, votes, playtime, dates). Verify terms before enabling.

sources.name: DealNews daily deals
sources.robots_note: robots.txt checked 2026-09-22: Crawl-delay 2 (honoured); the feed URL is not disallowed.
sources.terms_note: Copyright DealNews, all rights reserved (feed <copyright>). Headlines, prices exactly as stated and links only; a price is an observation at retrieval time, never a current price. Verify terms before enabling.

sources.name: Coupon codes published by merchants, entered by staff
sources.terms_note: Only codes a merchant published itself, entered with the URL of that page as evidence. Validity and expiry stay unknown unless the merchant states them; no code is 'working' because it was entered.

sources.name: SEC EDGAR: latest XBRL filings
sources.robots_note: robots.txt checked 2026-09-22: /Archives/edgar is allowed; /cgi-bin is disallowed, so the EDGAR 'getcurrent' Atom feed is deliberately not used.
sources.terms_note: Public EDGAR data. SEC fair-access policy: a User-Agent that names the requester and a contact (ours does) and at most 10 requests per second. Informational context only — no advice, no execution.
